Fields are the spec's own (payment_method card object with card_number_type; allowance with

THE CARD NUMBER AND CVC BELOW ARE THE POINT OF THIS FIXTURE. They are Stripe's published test PAN and a
dummy CVC — never a real credential — and they exist so a test can assert that NEITHER value appears in the
refusal response NOR in anything the gateway logs. Pivota refuses this endpoint without reading the body;
this fixture is what proves it.
